mappings.assertion: TestA4VocabularySpelling pins the new typed set discoveryDisposition (deferred, dismissed) by literal expectations independent of the constants, and TestA4DiscoveryDispositionSentinels asserts that exactly those two values are sentinels and that case variants, prefixes, a task ID and the empty string are not; the set-discovery-disposition oracle cases (dismissed, task_ref, invalid_refused beside the older success and refused) keep the refusal text naming both sentinels byte-identical. Negative proof, restored: changing the dismissed spelling failed TestA4VocabularySpelling and TestA4DiscoveryDispositionSentinels.

TestA4VocabularySpelling pins every new named string value by literal (operation names, completion-authorization lock, label prefix and reason codes, the two role-pair fallbacks, the provider-audit pattern, the rejection-RCA, obligation-drift, transition and replacement history keys, the two alert categories) and TestA4NamedNumbers pins the thresholds and file permissions in decimal. Boundary characterisations for the renamed thresholds: TestA4SuspiciousRateBoundaries (count 2 versus 3 and rate 95 versus 96 on both the verdict and the task-outcome metric), TestA4RepeatedFailureWakeThreshold (one versus two failures) and TestA4AmendReasonLimit (4096 versus 4097 bytes, multi-byte reason, blank reason). Negative proofs, each restored: threshold 95 to 94, minimum count 3 to 2 and reason limit 4096 to 4097 each failed the matching boundary test and the value pin.

TestOracleVocabularyPaths adds the seven cases (analyze/checkpoint_response, analyze/active_checkpoint_rerun, set-discovery-disposition/dismissed, /task_ref, /invalid_refused, add-human-note/all, update-sprint-metrics/below_threshold) with json, human and state goldens and the three vocab- fixtures. They were committed in bb2329009, an oracle-only commit that precedes the substitutions, generated by regen -mode write-new from the unchanged production tree; regen -mode check -pkg ./internal/oracle/a4 reproduces them and every older A4 golden, which are untouched. No existing oracle file, fixture or golden is edited.

The live A4 oracles (TestOracleSprintCheckpoint, TestOracleUpdateSprintMetrics, TestOracleAnalyze, TestOracleAddHumanNote, TestOracleSetDiscoveryDisposition and the seven new cases) and the A3 oracles run against their unchanged goldens under make test; every renamed value keeps its spelling, so error text, lock names, report bytes, history keys, alert categories and persisted state are unchanged, and the exported ops surface is untouched.

test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and oracle suites including the new spelling and boundary tests; lint, test-e2e, the ops race run and the A4 regeneration check are mandatory with it.
